verdict.rationale: Ramp is a finance platform with in-product AI (Ramp Intelligence, agents that learn from past invoices). Whether customer data is used for model training is therefore a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or a data-usage control. OAuth scopes, MCP access restrictions and sandbox isolation are adjacent controls that govern access, not training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
